gui.grimstorage.xp.hint1: Click: take a level  ·  Shift-click: take 10
gui.grimstorage.xp.hint2: Right-click: store all of your XP
gui.grimstorage.bus.whitelist.tooltip: Whitelist: only what is in the filter slots moves. Empty filter = nothing.
gui.grimstorage.bus.blacklist.tooltip: Blacklist: everything moves except what is in the filter slots. Empty filter = everything.
gui.grimstorage.bus.match.tooltip: Exact match: enchantments, damage and other data must match too. Ignore NBT: any item of that type matches.
gui.grimstorage.bus.toggle.import: %s: click to turn importing on or off
gui.grimstorage.bus.toggle.export: %s: click to turn exporting on or off
gui.grimstorage.bus.slot: Click an item here to filter it. Buckets and tanks filter their fluid or chemical.
gui.grimstorage.bus.direction.tooltip: Click to switch this bus between Import (takes things from the block into your network) and Export (sends things from your network into the block).
tooltip.grimstorage.import_bus: Takes everything out of the block it faces and puts it in your network.
tooltip.grimstorage.export_bus: Sends things FROM your network INTO the block it faces. Pick what to send in its screen.
tooltip.grimstorage.bus.how: Use it on a chest or machine your Soul Cable runs up to, and it goes onto the cable.
tooltip.grimstorage.bus.switch: Wrong one? Right-click the bus and switch it in its screen.
message.grimstorage.export_bus.placed: Export Bus: sends from your network into this block. To pull items into the network, use an Import Bus or switch it in its screen.
tooltip.grimstorage.wrench.cable: Click a cable connection to cut it. Click again to join it back.
tooltip.grimstorage.wrench.bus: Click a bus on a cable to take it off.
tooltip.grimstorage.wrench.rotate: Click a machine to turn it toward the side you clicked.
tooltip.grimstorage.wrench.pickup: Sneak-click any Grim Storage block to pick it up.
gui.grimstorage.bulk.hint_xp: Click to take a level, shift-click for 10, right-click to store all your XP.
gui.grimstorage.bulk.hint_pool: Stored as one big pool. Move it with buses or a Network Interface.
gui.grimstorage.bus.upgrade_slot: Speed Upgrade: each one adds the bus's base speed again (up to 8, for 9x).
gui.grimstorage.machine_bus.learn.toolti: The network learns every recipe the machine in front can make, no cards needed: furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces, plus machines from Mekanism, Create, Ender IO, Ars Nouveau, Immersive Engineering and more.
gui.grimstorage.machine_bus.fuel.tooltip: Furnaces get coal, charcoal or other fuel from the network when they have something to cook. Powered machines get energy from the network's energy cells.
gui.grimstorage.jobs.empty_hint1: Click an item marked Craft to order it.
gui.grimstorage.jobs.empty_hint2: Every step shows up here while it runs.
gui.grimstorage.jobs.cancel: Cancel this job. Anything already made stays in storage.
gui.grimstorage.settings.jei.tooltip: The terminal and your recipe viewer (JEI, EMI or REI) share one search. Typing in either one searches both.
gui.grimstorage.settings.jei.missing: Needs JEI, EMI or REI installed.
gui.grimstorage.settings.focus.tooltip: Puts the cursor in the search box as soon as the terminal opens, so you can just start typing. Esc still closes it.
gui.grimstorage.settings.keep.tooltip: Opening the terminal again shows what you last searched for.
gui.grimstorage.settings.size.tooltip: Auto fits your screen. Normal is 6 rows, Tall 9, Taller 12. Showing %s rows (up to %s fit here).
gui.grimstorage.write_card: Write this recipe on a Recipe Card from your inventory (a blank one first). The items stay in the grid.
gui.grimstorage.write_card.no_card: Carry a Recipe Card to write the recipe on
jei.grimstorage.processing.items_only: Processing Cards hold items only: this recipe has no item going in or coming out
jei.grimstorage.terminal.fill: Fill the crafting grid from the network
jei.grimstorage.terminal.missing: %s ingredient(s) not in the network or your inventory
gui.grimstorage.access.mode.tooltip: Private: only you, the players you trust and server operators can open its blocks, use wireless terminals on it, or break and add its blocks. Open: anyone can.
gui.grimstorage.access.none: Nobody yet. Add a player by name below.
gui.grimstorage.access.name: Player name
gui.grimstorage.access.owner_only: Only the owner can change this.
message.grimstorage.access.unknown: No player called %s has been on this server
gui.grimstorage.card.variants.tooltip: Any: other items the recipe also takes will do (any planks, any wool, any logs), so a craft doesn't fail because you're out of oak. Exact: only the items on the card.
gui.grimstorage.preview.short: Can't start: %s item(s) missing, shown in red
gui.grimstorage.preview.cant: Can't start: this would need itself (a loop)
gui.grimstorage.chest_link.nothing: Face it at a chest, barrel or drawer.
gui.grimstorage.chest_link.mode.tooltip: In and out: the chest is part of your storage. Only put in: the network fills it but never takes from it. Only take out: the network uses what's inside but never adds to it.
gui.grimstorage.chest_link.first.tooltip: On: new items go into this chest before your storage cells. Off: only once the cells are full (items the chest already holds still go there first).
gui.grimstorage.emitter.mode.tooltip: At or above: a signal when the network has at least this many. Below: a signal while it has fewer. Craft while powered: when this block gets a redstone signal, it crafts the item up to this many.
gui.grimstorage.settings.alerts.tooltip: A pop-up in the corner when a craft you ordered is done, or has been stuck for a minute. Works anywhere, even far from the terminal.
gui.grimstorage.terminal.pin_hint: Alt-click to pin to the top
message.grimstorage.craft.your_limit: You already have %s crafting jobs running on this network. Wait for one to finish, or cancel one in the terminal's crafting tab.
gui.grimstorage.missing.data: %s more with other data (damaged, enchanted, named)

gui.grimstorage.missing.carried: %s in your inventory: put them in first

gui.grimstorage.missing.loop: Its recipes need it to make it
gui.grimstorage.job.recipe_missing: Waiting for its recipe card or machine
